project.name: Inspecto — Link Analysis graph algorithms (la-graph, optional)
project.description:
The server-side port of the SPA's graph algorithms (shortest path, centrality, PageRank, Louvain, suspicion score, ...), carved out of inspecto-geo-link as D-1 step 1 of the Link Analysis separation (docs/superpower/la-separation-d1-design.md). Plain JDK: NO dependency on any platform module, by design — that is what lets it be extracted before any SPI exists. Nothing calls it yet (D-4), so it is not in any bundle.
Built only under the edition profiles (see the parent pom's profile-scoped modules), alongside inspecto-geo-link. The parity tests read their fixtures from ../inspecto-ui/src/app/inspecto/graph, where the TypeScript specs read them too.
